Prototype injected at 1400x900 (the smokes' size): no wide-tier rule applies (panel 330, body 14 px, chips 14 px). Only the DOM additions show: Sampling/Output headings in today's 12 px caption style and the folded Conditioning.

Iteration 1, kept for the record. Defects found and fixed later: Check's focus ring black on black (from color-scheme:dark), Conditioning note wrapped to two lines, 7 gallery columns. Also in v1 but not visible in this shot: the Refine source overflowed its pane, and the docked check added a 24 px row gap that moved the gallery.

risks: color-scheme: dark changes Chromium's outline:auto focus ring to near-black on this background. Iteration 1 showed Check's focus invisible. The explicit :focus-visible rings must ship in the same commit as color-scheme, or keyboard focus disappears page-wide.

The docked check is a second scroll container whose height is the viewer's (791 px at QHD; min 560 when the viewer is idle). A long critic answer or comparison now scrolls inside the dock instead of growing the page. focus() on the h2 or #critic-result still scrolls it into view, but two scroll regions are a learnable cost. It also relies on :has() (Chromium 105+, Firefox 121+, Safari 15.4+); without :has() the check stays above the viewer as today.

A bigger scale makes the panel taller: 1189 px at QHD with the last-run banner (1201 px available), and 1252 px at 2048x1040 before the density tier. Any later addition to the panel needs the measured sticky top; with the grid fold open the panel sticks by its bottom, so the prompt scrolls away while you are at Run grid.
field-sizing: content is Chromium-only: Firefox keeps rows=5 plus the min-height. The prompt box also grows while typing, which moves Generate down within the panel.

The viewer's result column duplicates three card actions. It must re-render after setFavorite resolves (the prototype does), it deliberately has no Delete, and it disappears once a second image lands, so batches behave as today.
object-fit: contain on cards is a visible change of taste: letterbox bars on 16:9 and 7:9. It is the honest view (M46), but the user may prefer cover; a one-line toggle could restore it.
Refine loads the full PNG (several MB at 4 MP) instead of the 384 px thumbnail, at the wide tier only. That is a local file, but decode time is noticeable on a 4 MP source.

The Conditioning fold hides the LoRA select from someone who uses adapters on every image. Mitigations: it auto-opens while a LoRA is selected, and its summary names the adapter. Consider remembering its open state with the panel.

The prototype wraps globals (card, openRefine, syncRefine, appendResult, clearResults) from an injected script. That works only because the page's scripts share one global scope. The real change edits those functions in place; nothing should be monkey-patched.
The 58vh cap shrinks the just-made image from 887 to 757 px at 1305 tall, the price of the 8 x 241 px gallery row above the fold. The lightbox remains the place to inspect at size.
rule_conflicts: Frontend rule 'no build step; classic scripts sharing one global scope; only app.js runs anything at load'. The headings and the Conditioning fold go into index.html. The result column goes inside panel.js appendResult/clearResults, and the crop frame inside refine.js syncRefine/openRefine. The sticky-top ResizeObserver is registered from app.js, the one file that runs at load. All new names stay top-level declarations; no prototype-style reassignment of globals.

'On a two-column page validation lives above the results ... the prompt check's panel follows it (placeTagValidation moves both ...)'. Kept as is: the dock is pure CSS grid placement of the same nodes inside #tag-validation-wide, placeTagValidation and its focus/selection preservation are untouched, and below 901 px both nodes still return under Prompt.

'Check pressed on a two-column page moves focus to the panel heading (checkFromButton)'. The heading is now at the top of the dock; its scroll-margin-top:72px still clears the 56 px topbar. smoke-analysis's 'heading top >= topbar bottom' and 'r.bottom <= innerHeight' run at 1400x900, where nothing changes. Add a 2560x1305 run (see phasing) to hold the docked case.

'Both are greyed rather than hidden where they do not apply ... the panel keeps its shape, and the badge says why' (index.html:226-228, and the True CFG note). The collapse keeps every caption, ? badge and note. Only the empty chips row is hidden, and the dead negative box shrinks to one line, so 'dim the textarea, not the whole field' still holds. The fold moves LoRA and references but never hides the reason.

smoke-conditioning sets els.lora.value and calls els.lora.onchange() directly, firing no DOM event. The fold's note and auto-open must therefore be written by sizes.js syncConditioning, not by event listeners as in the prototype.

smoke-animagine expects a valid chip's font-size === '12px' and the colour rgb(242,244,247). True at 1400 since the tier is >=1800 only; a future wide smoke must read the token value (13.5 px) instead.

Design note 'The running batch on wide screens' (the 8-column .viewer.many tier, with the single and 2-4 image tiers keeping their layout). The many tier is untouched. The prototype raises .viewer.multi to 40vh and caps the single image at 58vh: update that note's last sentence alongside.

The refine dialog contract (openRefine fills it from the record; aria-disabled Refine with the reason as title; Escape; Ctrl+Enter; remembered scale/versions/strength; a sweep opens its sheet; a ⤢ on a checkpoint without a pass opens nothing) is unchanged. Only the thumbnail src (rec.url at the wide tier) and the frame are added. The scale buttons' new ::after reads their existing title, so the title must stay the WxH string.

aria-disabled vs disabled: no control changes kind. The Ctrl+Enter chip uses content: "Ctrl+Enter" / "" so Generate's accessible name stays 'Generate'. Smokes read els.generate.textContent, which is unaffected, including 'Generate (queue)'.
'Reset sits at the far end of the Prompt caption, away from Generate': kept, via margin-left:auto instead of float.
Card tools 'revealed by keyboard focus and on a coarse pointer too': kept. The word label shows on :focus-visible as well as :hover.
Panel persistence: no new localStorage key; the fold's open state is derived, not stored.
directions.effort_estimate:
About 4-5 developer-days in total, most of it CSS:
- Token pass, wide and short tiers, controls, presets and gallery: about 1.5 days.
- Dock: half a day including the 2560 smoke.
- Refine two-pane and crop frame: about 1 day (CSS plus about 40 lines in refine.js).
- Viewer result column: half a day in panel.js.
- Headings, Conditioning fold and syncConditioning note: half a day.
- Measured sticky panel: 1-2 hours.
- Porting VIEWPORT/DPR into tools/browser.mjs and writing smoke-wide.json: half a day.

No backend change.

directions.name: Studio workbench
principles: Height is the scarce axis at QHD (2560x1305), so the page itself does not scroll at 1800 px and wider. Each column scrolls itself, and nothing the user needs falls below the fold. Measured: document height 1837 px before, 1305 after (equal to the viewport).

The canvas is never empty and never somewhere else. It shows exactly one thing at a time: the newest result, the selected image, a pass beside its source, a Refine source with its crop frame, or the sheet. The strip above it says which: 'Latest result', 'Image 14', 'Refining image 5', 'Contact sheet run:...'. A fresh load opens on the newest library image instead of an empty 380 px box.

Select, then act. One click on a library card, sheet cell or batch tile selects it into the inspector, where every action has a labelled button. A second click or Enter zooms in the lightbox, which stays the 1:1 surface. Card overlays keep only Reuse, Refine and Star, so Delete is no longer 4 px from the star.

Primary actions are fixed in place. Generate (plus Run grid while the grid fold is open) sits in a footer at y=1232-1276 at every scroll position and fold state. Refine's Run button is sticky at the foot of its panel.

Controls belong next to what they change. The prompt check docks between the prompt column and the canvas, not above the image. Run status sits in a strip on top of the canvas, not under Generate. Refine's controls sit beside the source they act on.

One caption style and one token set. Sentence-case 14 px captions replace both the 12 px uppercase and the 11 px label styles. Uppercase 11 px is kept only for group headings (Frame, Sampling, Conditioning, Output, Grid search). The type steps up only at 100% QHD (2200 px and wider); at 125% scaling a CSS pixel is already 1.25 device pixels.

Keep every deliberate contract of the page. The ids, the `els` table, `collect()` sending `refine: null`, the aria-disabled buttons, `placeTagValidation`'s two hosts and the lightbox are all unchanged. The prototype only moves nodes and wraps six global functions.
directions.layout:
**2560x1305 at DPR 1 (primary), 1800 px and wider: three columns.** The topbar is 48 px. `main` is `grid-template-columns: clamp(400px,17vw,460px) minmax(0,1fr) clamp(420px,21vw,580px)`, with 16 px gaps and padding and a height of `calc(100vh - 48px)`. The body has `overflow: hidden`.

- **Control column, 435 px** (x 16-451, y 64-1289). A scrolling body holds the groups Prompt, Frame, Sampling, Conditioning, Output and Grid search. A pinned footer holds Generate (325x44 at y=1232), Run grid when the fold is open, and a Ctrl+Enter key hint.
- **Stage, 1523 px** (x 467-1990). The status strip is 46-62 px tall; it carries the canvas title, the progress bars, the cell note, Back and the last-run banner. Below it is the canvas, 1150 px tall.
  - A 896x1152 render shows at 868x1116, against 690x887 before: 58% more area.
  - A 1024x1024 Refine source shows at 1024x1024, which is 1:1.
  - A pass and its source show side by side at about 724 px each.
  - A batch of 4 shows as 2x2 at 552 px each, against 34vh (444 px) before.
  - With the prompt check open, the stage becomes `minmax(460px,34%) 1fr`: the check (about 518 px) beside the canvas, and the image stays fully visible. Before, the image was pushed to y=649 and only 656 of its 887 px were on screen.
  - The contact sheet replaces the canvas in the same grid area.
- **Rail, 538 px** (x 2006-2544). The inspector is at most 50% of the rail's height (74% while Refine is open). The library fills the rest with a sticky search head and a `minmax(118px,1fr)` grid: 4 columns and 20 cards fully visible, against one row of 12 at y=1105 before. The 'Wide' toggle sets `main.library`: the rail becomes `display: contents`, the library takes the canvas column (6 columns of about 240 px, 1482 px wide) and the inspector stays in column 3.

**2048x1040 at DPR 1.25.** The same three columns at 400 / 1162 / 430 px; the type stays at 14 px body and 13.5 px captions because the 2200 px step-up does not apply. The canvas image is 665x855 and Generate sits at y=969-1013. The library shows 3 columns and 9 cards fully visible. Refine takes about 60% of the rail, leaving about 1.5 rows of library. The size presets wrap to 2 rows; True CFG fits on one line once the column minimum is 400 px.

**1400x900 (smokes), 1100-1799 px: two columns.** The control column (400 px) is sticky with its own scroll and pinned Generate (y=829), spanning both rows. The stage (943 px) fills the first screen: canvas 943x719, image 533x685. The rail drops under the canvas as inspector | library side by side, and the page scrolls. An open Refine becomes a fixed 420 px side sheet over the canvas's right edge, and the stage gets a matching right margin, so the source stays visible beside its controls. Below 1100 px the existing single-column layout and its 901 px `placeTagValidation` rule are untouched.

changes.change: A fixed 100vh workspace: three columns `var(--col-controls) minmax(0,1fr) var(--col-rail)` with `main` height `calc(100vh - 48px)` and `body{overflow:hidden}`; each column scrolls on its own. The two-column variant (1100-1799 px) keeps a sticky control column with internal scroll, spanning both grid rows, which also fixes the media-query ordering bug that left it sticky past the fold.

Group headings Frame, Sampling, Conditioning and Output are added; the empty references chip row is hidden on checkpoints without references; the narrow fields widen to 72 px.

Tiny buttons go to 12 px and hints and tips to 13 px. Size presets lose the all-green 'recommended' fill: recommendation is a small green dot and selection is the accent. Checkboxes get a focus-visible ring.

changes.surface: Status strip (new #studio-status at the top of .stage)

The strip carries the canvas title ('Latest result', 'Image 14', 'Refining image 5', 'Contact sheet run:...'), a 7 px bar, 14 px text and '← Latest results'. The last-run banner shrinks to an inline chip.

changes.surface: Canvas (#viewer and new #studio-focus in the stage's canvas area)

The grid is `minmax(118px,1fr)`: 4 columns and 20 cards visible at QHD. A 'Wide' toggle gives the library the canvas column (6 columns of about 240 px) while the inspector stays visible. Reuse no longer scrolls the page to the top; it scrolls the control column only when the prompt is out of view.

changes.surface: Contact sheet (#sheet in the canvas area)
changes.change: The sheet opens in the canvas, where it is in view immediately. It is titled 'Contact sheet' with the run in the strip and has Back. Cells size to the 1523 px canvas instead of 2161 px. A cell click inspects it (star, Reuse, Refine) without the lightbox round trip, and the library shows a note while the sheet is open.

changes.surface: Refine (the #refine-dialog <dialog> moved into the inspector; show() instead of showModal())

The canvas shows the source at 1:1 (1024x1024 at QHD) with a dashed frame and a dimmed outside for the region refine.fitted keeps ('→ 1536×1024 · keeps the middle 100% × 67%'). The 72 px thumbnail is hidden. The scale buttons become a 4-segment control that shows each output size (1.5× / 1536×1536). A `.help .tip` inside the control column, inspector or library is positioned `fixed` from its badge's rect on hover or focus, so `overflow:auto` cannot clip it. Measured: the True CFG tip spans x 384-684 over the canvas edge. This is needed for the existing ? badges to keep working in a scrolling column.

risks: Making Refine non-modal removes the inert background and the focus trap. The control column and Generate are live while a pass is being set up, so Ctrl+Enter has to be routed by focus (in the panel = Refine, elsewhere = Generate) and Escape needs an app handler. A user can also leave Refine open and forget it; the strip title 'Refining image N' is the only cue. The prototype handles all three, but a production version must also make sure a library delete of the open source still refuses cleanly, as smoke-refine checks today.

Select-on-click changes what a card click means: it used to open the lightbox and now selects, with a second click zooming. Anyone used to one click opening full size pays a click. Arrow-key walking moves from the lightbox to Tab and focus. The inspector changes on focus and needs a polite live region (role=status on its title) to be announced.

Without page scroll, the gallery's IntersectionObserver (`rootMargin 400px` against the viewport, app.js moreWatcher) fires only once Load more is actually visible inside the rail. It must be rebuilt with `root: #studio-library`. resetGallery after every job still empties the rail and resets its scroll (M39 stays unless that is fixed separately).

Tooltips, the Examples menu, the tag menu (`left:-68px`) and the tag suggestions now live inside `overflow:auto` columns. The prototype lifts `.help .tip` to fixed positioning on hover or focus. A tip left open while its column scrolls is mispositioned, and the tag menu on tag checkpoints will clip unless it gets the same treatment. Animagine, WAI and Kohaku were not exercised.

Short windows: the workspace is height-bound. Below about 800 px of height at 1800 px or wider, the canvas and the 50% inspector cap get cramped. The two-column 1100-1799 layout should then apply by height too (add `and (min-height: 820px)` to the three-column query).
With Refine open at 125% or on narrow rails, the library drops to 1-1.5 rows. Re-pointing Refine by clicking another card is therefore harder there than at QHD.
The rail inspector duplicates much of the lightbox side column. Two places now show facts and actions and must stay in step: one helper should render both.

The inspector's 'Re-render at W×H' uses `/api/rerender` with `search: hash:<content_hash>`, which also matches byte-identical duplicates. Production needs an exact single-image selector, such as an `id:` search term or an `ids` field on RerenderRequest.

The prototype wraps six globals (appendResult, openRefine, syncRefine, setSheet, syncSize, reuseIntoPanel) and intercepts clicks in the capture phase. That is fine for a demo but brittle. Production must put the hooks in the owning files: generation.js show(), refine.js, sheet.js, sizes.js and gallery.js.

The canvas's 'many' tier (more than 4 results) uses auto-fill 200 px cells: 7 per row in a 1523 px canvas. The 'running batch on wide screens' note promises 8; keep `repeat(8, minmax(0,1fr))` there at 2200 px and wider to honour it.
rule_conflicts: **Refine stays the dialog's.** 'A refine pass is the Refine dialog's (web/refine.js), never the panel's … Ctrl+Enter in the dialog runs the pass, not Generate.' app.js:257-262 runs runRefine whenever `els.refineDialog.open`, which is now true while the user types in the prompt. Keep the rule's purpose by routing on focus: `if (els.refineDialog.open && els.refineDialog.contains(e.target)) runRefine(); else generate();`. The dialog element stays the same <dialog> with the same ids, still filled by openRefine; only refine.js:157 changes, from showModal() to show() at 1100 px and wider. `refineSource` set while open and null after, and `collect()` sending refine:null, are unchanged.

**Escape and focus on the docked dialog.** The design note 'A dialog, not a mode of the panel' and index.html:533-539 describe it as 'Modal like the lightbox: focus stays inside, Escape closes it'. Non-modal loses the inert page and native Escape, so add an app-level Escape that closes it unless a menu or the lightbox is open. tools/browser.mjs's comment ('Escape also closes a modal <dialog>') still holds for the lightbox, and smoke-refine's Escape step passes because the app handler is on document. Update the note's wording.

**smoke.json and the card click.** smoke.json does `document.querySelector('.card img').click()` and expects the lightbox. Under select-then-zoom the smoke needs a second click or an Enter keydown. Everything else in smoke.json's lightbox steps uses lightbox-internal coordinates at 1400x900 and is unaffected. Alternatively, keep a plain card click opening the lightbox below 1800 px, where there is no canvas, so the smokes' 1400x900 run is unchanged.

**Where the check lives.** 'On a two-column page validation lives above the results … under 901 px the same node returns below Prompt. The prompt check's panel follows it (placeTagValidation …).' placeTagValidation and both hosts are untouched; the wide host's children are placed by CSS grid areas into a dock beside the canvas instead of above it. Update the rule text to 'beside the results'. smoke-analysis's 'moving from the wide host back under the prompt with focus and selection kept' still applies below 901 px.

**Twelve classic scripts.** 'The page script is classic scripts sharing one global scope … only app.js, the last, runs anything at load' and 'twelve classic scripts'. The selection model and inspector should be a thirteenth declarations-only file, studio.js between refine and tags, wired in app.js. CLAUDE.md's layout list, state.js's load-order header and the 'The page script is twelve files' design note need the new count.

**Paging.** 'The gallery pages … as "Load more" scrolls near the viewport (moreWatcher, re-armed by watchMore …)'. At 1800 px and wider the IntersectionObserver must take `root: document.getElementById('studio-library')` with the same rootMargin, or paging triggers late. smoke-paging runs at 1400x900, where the page still scrolls, so add a QHD paging step to a new smoke-studio.json.

**Reuse scrolling.** The 'Per-control defaults and Reuse' behaviour scrolls the window to the top (gallery.js:401). In the workbench the window does not scroll; scroll the control column only when the prompt is out of view. This keeps the purpose of showing the filled prompt.

**'The running batch on wide screens'.** Eight columns at 2000 px and wider for more than 4 results: keep `repeat(8, ...)` in the canvas at 2200 px and wider. The 2-4 tier changes from 34vh to a 2x2 equal grid, which needs a sentence in that note.

**smoke-refine.json.** Its steps ('no refine control in the panel', card and lightbox Refine opening the dialog with the panel untouched, Escape, Ctrl+Enter, the remembered strength, Reset forgetting it, a source deleted while open) all hold, with two exceptions. Its Ctrl+Enter step must focus a field inside the dialog first. The 'dialog' becomes the docked panel at 1800 px and wider, or the side sheet at 1400x900.

**'forgetImages is the one place the page drops deleted ids'.** The inspector's selection and the canvas focus must clear through forgetImages, which removes every [data-id] node, rather than through their own check after deleteImage as the prototype does.

**Unchanged rules.** aria-disabled on Generate and Run grid, Ask the critic aria-disabled and focusable, and the panel's `input`/`change` persistence delegation on `.panel` are untouched: the footer is still inside .panel, and the moved nodes keep their ids and listeners.
directions.effort_estimate:
About 6-8 developer-days for vanilla CSS/JS with no build step:
- tokens and type: 0.5 d
- control column with pinned footer and groups: 0.5 d
- workspace grid, status strip and canvas sizing: 1.5 d
- check dock: 0.5 d
- selection model and inspector as studio.js, with focus handling and a live region: 1.5 d
- docked Refine (show(), key routing, crop frame, segmented scales, source/pass compare, side sheet): 1-1.5 d
- IntersectionObserver root, tooltip lifting and tag-menu clipping: 0.5 d
- smokes (new smoke-studio.json at 2560x1305; smoke.json, smoke-refine.json, smoke-analysis.json adjustments) and design-notes/CLAUDE.md updates: 1-1.5 d

The prototype (proto.css about 19 KB, proto.js about 21 KB) already proves the DOM moves and the wrapping points.
phasing: 1. Tokens and type, no layout change: color-scheme dark, accent-color, --line-strong borders, placeholder colour, the #6d4ff2 primary, one 14 px sentence-case caption style, 12-13 px small text, recommended-as-dot presets, checkbox focus ring; the bigger scale only at 2200 px and wider (M17, M30, M31, M36, M69, M74, M78).

2. Control column: wrap the panel in a scroll body plus a pinned footer (Generate, Run grid when the fold is open, Ctrl+Enter hint), add the group headings, and fix the media-query order so the column is never sticky past the fold (M1, M70, M84). This ships alone in the current two-column page.
3. Status strip: move #progress, #queue-note, #cell-note, #error and #last-run into a strip at the top of .stage with a canvas title (M24, M25). Smokes read these by id, so they keep passing.

4. Canvas sizing and check dock: the viewer fills a definite-height stage row; 2x2 grid for batches of 2-4; the check and chips take a dock column beside the canvas through grid areas (M3, M21, M40, M41, M59).

5. Three columns at 1800 px and wider: add #studio-rail with the gallery head, grid and Load more; no page scroll; IntersectionObserver root on the rail; Reuse scrolls the control column; Wide library toggle; sheet in the canvas area (M4, M14, M16, M27, M75, M86).

6. Selection and inspector (studio.js): click selects and a second click or Enter zooms; inspector facts and labelled actions (Refine…, Open full size, Reuse, Use seed, Re-render, Run as sheet, Delete); pass badges and lineage chip; newest-in-library on a fresh load; sheet-cell and batch-tile inspect; forgetImages clears the selection (M15, M20, M32, M34, M35, M43, M45, M47, M48, M5). Update smoke.json's card click.

7. Docked Refine: move #refine-dialog into the inspector and use show() at 1100 px and wider; Escape and Ctrl+Enter routed by focus; source at 1:1 in the canvas with the crop frame; segmented scales with output sizes; Strength focused; source beside pass when it lands; the 420 px side sheet from 1100 to 1799 px (M6, M51, M52, M91, M92, M108). Update smoke-refine.json's Ctrl+Enter step and the 'A dialog, not a mode of the panel' design note.

8. Docs and checks: add tools/smoke-studio.json at VIEWPORT 2560x1305 covering three-column geometry, the pinned Generate, paging inside the rail, select/zoom, docked Refine keys and the crop frame. Update CLAUDE.md's Frontend rules (where the check lives, the thirteen scripts, Refine docking) and the design-notes sections listed in rule_conflicts.

directions.name: Image-first loop
directions.thesis: At QHD the page should be built around the image, not the form. The image you just made, or the one you picked, stays on screen at 1:1. The gallery sits beside it as a shelf that scrolls on its own. One toolbar acts on the selected image, and each action shows its key. Refine and the prompt check open over the shelf, never over the image or above it. A compare view (swipe, side by side, hold to flip, both sides zooming together) turns "did the pass help?" into one gesture. The controls become a collapsible rail whose Generate button never leaves the screen.
principles: The image is always on screen: at 2560x1305 a 1 MP render is drawn at exactly 1024x1024 (1:1 device pixels, measured), with no lightbox needed. Before, it was 887x887 (68vh) and scrolled away as soon as the gallery was used.

One selection, one toolbar. Clicking a thumbnail selects it into the stage. Star, Reuse, Refine, Compare, Pin A, Sheet, Zoom and Delete act on the selection, and each button shows its key. This replaces six glyph-only 23-29 px tools on every card.
Secondary surfaces open beside the image, not above it or over it. The Refine drawer and the prompt check take the shelf's rectangle (742 px), so the image never moves.
Every column scrolls itself, and from 1600 CSS px the page never scrolls (scrollHeight 1305 = viewport). Generate is pinned to the rail's foot, so it can never be scrolled away or pinned off-screen.

A comparison is a view, not a hunt. Source and refined (or a pinned A and the selected B) share one frame, one zoom and one pan. The source is cover-cropped the way refine.fitted crops it, so the two line up pixel for pixel.
Keys are shown where the actions are: a kbd badge on every toolbar button, the walk/flip/? keys in the image HUD, the full list in a Keys popover, and Ctrl+Enter on Generate and on Refine.

Feedback appears where the result lands. Progress, queue, errors and the finished line sit at the foot of the stage, between the rail's Generate and the strip where the images land. The tab title also shows progress.
The controls are secondary: a 360-420 px rail with Sampling and Output group headings. '[' hides it, and a Generate button then appears in the topbar.
directions.layout:
2560x1305 (QHD at 100%, measured on the prototype):
- Topbar: 48 px.
- Main: a grid of rail | stage | shelf, padding 10/16 px, height calc(100vh - 48px). The page does not scroll (document scrollHeight 1305; before, it was 1475 with 13 images and grew with every row).
- Rail: 420 px (clamp(360px, 17vw, 420px)). It scrolls itself; Generate is sticky at its foot (y 983-1029) and reads 'Generate Ctrl+Enter'. Body text 15 px, hints 13 px (before: 14 and 11).
- Stage (1342 px wide):
  - Stagebar, 46 px: caption on two lines ('Image 15 · 1024×1024 · seed 32 · 28 steps · CFG 3.5 · FLUX.1-Krea-dev' plus the prompt), a lineage chip on refined images ('⤢ refined from 11 at 0.1', which selects the source), and nine actions with kbd badges.
  - Focus area, 1342x1078: the image at fit, capped at one image pixel per device pixel, so a 1024² is exactly 1024x1024. A 34 px HUD row holds Single | Swipe | Side by side · Fit · 1:1 · zoom readout · the walk/flip/? keys.
  - Bottom row, 92 px: a status block (clamp(340px, 34%, 480px)) holding progress bars, Pause/Cancel, queue, cell note, error and last-run; then the 'This session' strip of 76 px thumbnails from every job this session, newest at the right.
- Shelf: 742 px (clamp(440px, 29vw, 760px)). A header (Gallery count, Runs, search, Favorites, All models, S/M/L, Sheet, Delete unstarred), then its own scroller with 4 columns of 173 px contained thumbnails (before: 12 columns of 171 px cover-cropped cards starting at y 1105, mostly below the fold).
- Overlays and spans: the prompt check and the Refine drawer cover the shelf's rectangle. The contact sheet spans stage and shelf (2104 px), so a 2x4 sheet fits in the viewport.

2048x1040 at DPR 1.25 (125%):
- Same three columns: rail 360, stage 1038, shelf 594 (3 columns of 179 px). Base font stays 14 px, since Windows already scales.
- Focus 1038x816, so a 1024² shows at 764 CSS px (93% of 1:1 device pixels).
- The Refine drawer is 594 px wide and the scale segment still shows each output size.
- The rail's size presets wrap to three rows. That is the tightest spot.

1400x900 (the smoke size):
- No app shell. Two columns: rail 330 + stage 1001.
- The stage keeps the stagebar, a focus area of 64vh (576 px, so a 1024² at 524 px) and the status/strip row. The caption truncates.
- The shelf drops under the stage (6 columns of 160 px) and the page scrolls (2624 px). Refine stays the modal dialog.
- The recommendation is to gate every behaviour change at 1600 px as well, so that below 1600 the page and all 1400x900 smokes stay as shipped.

changes.change: From 1600 CSS px, main becomes a full-height grid: var(--rail-w) minmax(0,1fr) var(--shelf-w). Each column scrolls itself and body is overflow:hidden. The rail is position:relative with overflow-y:auto, no longer sticky at top:68px, which also retires the overridden max-height:900px unpin. #btn-generate is position:sticky; bottom:0 inside the rail. Measured: the page no longer scrolls, Generate is always at y 983-1029, and the gallery is visible beside the image instead of starting at y 1105.

changes.surface: Stage focus view (new, replaces the viewer as the primary surface)
changes.change: The selected record is drawn with explicit width/height/left/top (the lightbox's layout method, not a transform), at fit capped at 1/devicePixelRatio. Measured: a 1024² is 1024x1024 at QHD and 764 px at 125%. The wheel zooms about the pointer, a drag pans, and a click at fit opens the lightbox. On fresh load the newest gallery image is selected rather than showing a 380 px 'Generated images appear here' box. While a job runs, the live preview is overlaid at up to 640 px with the last image dimmed (opacity .28) and labelled 'Live preview - the image lands here'. Nothing collapses and regrows.

A 46 px bar over the image. The caption shows id · size · seed · steps · CFG · true CFG · checkpoint, then the prompt clamped to one line. Refined images get a lineage chip ('⤢ refined from 11 at 0.1') that selects the source. The actions carry visible kbd badges and aria-keyshortcuts: ☆ Star F, ↻ Reuse R ('Reuse pass…' on a refined image), ⤢ Refine… E, ⇆ Compare C, Pin A, ❐ Reference (only where references are supported), ⊞ Sheet S, ⛶ Zoom Enter, ⌦ Del. Refine is aria-disabled with the reason in its title on checkpoints without a pass. The per-card hover tool rows are removed at >=1600 because the toolbar acts on the selection.

Swipe mode: the refined/B layer is clipped by inset(0 0 0 X%) and follows the pointer, with a handle and two labels ('Source image 11 · 1024×1024', 'Refined image 14 · 1536×1536 · strength 0.1'). Side-by-side mode: two equal cells. Holding B flips to A. Zoom and pan apply to both layers identically, so 1:1 swipes the same crop. A source is cover-cropped (object-fit: cover), matching refine.fitted's scale-to-cover and centre crop. A refined result that lands opens straight into Swipe against its source. For any other pair, press A to pin an image, select another, then press C.

#viewer becomes a single 92 px horizontal strip of every image made this session, newest at the right, with a gap at each job's first image. clearResults no longer empties it at >=1600. Selection follows the newest image. Click selects, and double-click or Enter on the selected image opens the lightbox over viewerRecords. This replaces the 68vh/34vh/20vh tiers and the 8-column many-tier rule while keeping that rule's purpose: about 16 tiles visible at once.

These move into a block at the stage's bottom-left, beside the rail's Generate and left of the strip the images land in. It packs the run and step bars (6 px), Pause/Cancel, '1 more job queued · Cancel queued' and '5s elapsed · ~21s left'. The last-run banner is hidden while a job is watched, and document.title shows 'run 1/3 · Local Diffusion'. Notices sit roughly 400 px from both Generate and the image, instead of the 2,400 px from the gallery header measured before.

changes.surface: Gallery shelf (.gallery-head, #gallery, #sheet, #btn-more moved into a right column)
changes.change: 742 px column with a sticky header and its own scroller. Thumbnails use --card-min (S 120 / M 160 / L 240, giving 4 columns of 173 px at M), with object-fit: contain on #08080b. A hover/selected caption shows 'id · W×H · seed'. Refined cards get a '⤢ 0.1' chip. The selected card gets a 2 px --sel ring. Click selects; double-click or Enter on the selected card opens the lightbox. ←/→ move by 1 and ↑/↓ by the column count. The shelf scrolls independently of the image (verified: wheel over the shelf leaves the 1024² in place).

changes.surface: Refine: docked drawer instead of a 460 px modal (refine.js, index.html #refine-dialog)
changes.change: At >=1600 the same #refine-dialog opens non-modally over the shelf's rectangle. The source is shown large in the stage with a dashed kept-region frame ('→ 1536×1024 · 1.6 MP · keeps 100% × 67% of the source'). Scale is a 4-segment control, each segment showing its output ('1.5× / 1536 × 1536', 'too large' when past the guard). Strength chips are built from the profile default (FLUX: 0.05 lighter · 0.1 default · 0.2 stronger · sweep 0.05,0.1,0.15,0.2). 'Passes of image N (k)' lists every earlier pass of this source, and clicking one compares it with the source. Strength is focused and selected on open. After Refine the drawer stays on the source with what was typed, and the result lands in the stage as a swipe against the source. Ctrl+Enter runs the pass only when focus is in the drawer.

At >=1600 the chip tray returns under the prompt in the rail; the rail now scrolls and Generate is pinned, so the original reason for moving it no longer applies. The prompt check (#tag-validation-wide, moved into the shelf) covers the shelf at 742 px instead of stretching 2161 px above the image. Encoders and Order sit side by side, the image stays in view, and Check still moves focus to the panel heading.

When the sheet is on it spans stage and shelf (2104 px) as the review surface, under the same header. S on a selected grid image opens its run's sheet. Measured: a 2x4 run fills the viewport with ~500 px cells and no page scroll.

When focus is not in a field: ←→ walk the list the selection came from (gallery pages on), ↑↓ move by gallery rows, Enter zooms, F stars, R reuses, E refines, C compares, A pins, S opens the run's sheet, Delete deletes after the existing confirm, B (held) flips, '[' hides the rail, '/' focuses search, '?' opens the Keys popover. Escape leaves the drawer (focus to the stage), then closes it. Ctrl+Enter is routed by focus: Refine drawer → the pass, Grid search fold → Run grid, anywhere else → Generate. That routing also stops the grid-fold Ctrl+Enter from rendering literal {placeholders}. Closing the lightbox returns focus to the card, and arrows keep working from it (verified).

The tokens above: 15 px base and 13 px hints at QHD 100%; input and ghost borders #4b4b5e; ::placeholder in --muted at opacity 1; .primary fill #6d4ff2; color-scheme: dark so the LoRA select and checkboxes go dark; recommended presets become a neutral pill with a green dot, and the selected one is the accent. 'Sampling' and 'Output' headings separate the rail. The empty reference chip row is hidden on checkpoints without references; the caption and note stay.
A 'Controls [' toggle in the topbar (and the '[' key) hides the rail. The stage takes the width, and a Generate button appears in the topbar.

directions.refine_redesign:
Refine stops being an interruption and becomes the second half of the loop.

**Opening it.** Select an image (click, or arrow to it) and press E, or click '⤢ Refine…' in the toolbar. At 1600 px and wider the existing #refine-dialog opens with show() instead of showModal(), docked over the gallery shelf's rectangle (742 px wide at QHD, 594 px at 125%). The stage keeps the source at full size: 1024x1024 at QHD instead of a 72 px cover-cropped thumbnail in a 460 px modal.

**The source in the stage.** A dashed frame draws the region the pass will keep at the typed W×H, with its outcome: '→ 1536×1024 · 1.6 MP · keeps 100% × 67% of the source'. A reshape's crop is visible before it costs a run.

**The drawer's controls.**
- Size is a 4-segment control, each segment showing its factor and output size ('1.25× / 1280 × 1280'; 'too large' past the guard).
- Strength is focused and selected on open. Under it is a row of chips built from the profile's own default: on FLUX '0.05 lighter · 0.1 default · 0.2 stronger · sweep 0.05,0.1,0.15,0.2', instead of a 0.4 placeholder that repaints FLUX.
- Versions and Seed sit beside Strength.
- The 'Prompt and sampling' fold and the server preview line ('1 image · strength 0.1 · about 3 of 28 steps run') are unchanged.
- Refine (Ctrl+Enter) is pinned at the drawer's foot.

**Running it.** On Refine the job queues as today, and its progress shows in the status block at the foot of the stage. The drawer re-opens at once on the same source with everything that was typed, so trying the next strength is one edit. The prototype verified this: drawer open, non-modal, refineSource 11.

**The result.** It lands in the session strip and is selected in the stage in Swipe mode against its source ('Source image 11 · 1024×1024' | 'Refined image 14 · 1536×1536 · strength 0.1'), cover-cropped exactly as refine.fitted crops it. Wheel or the 1:1 button zooms both sides together, Side by side splits the frame, and holding B flips.

**Passes of this image.** The drawer's 'Passes of image 11 (k)' grid lists every pass already made from this source, newest first. Clicking one compares it with the source, which is how a strength sweep is judged without its sheet.

**Lineage.** A refined image's caption carries '⤢ refined from 11 at 0.1', which selects the source. Gallery cards carry a '⤢ 0.1' chip.

**Closing.** Escape inside the drawer moves focus back to the stage; a second Escape or ✕ closes it.

**What stays the same.** collect() still sends refine: null. The drawer keeps its own size, strength, versions and seed. Reuse on a refined record still opens it on the source. Below 1600 px it stays the modal dialog it is today.

screenshots.caption: BEFORE, 2560x1305, 13 images. The 1024² result is drawn at 887x887 (68vh). The gallery starts at y 1105, so one partial row of 12 cover-cropped 171 px cards is visible. The 330 px panel has 14 px body text and 11 px hints.

AFTER, same data. Rail 420 px with Generate pinned. The stage shows the result at exactly 1024x1024 (1:1). The stagebar has its caption and nine keyed actions. The status block and session strip sit at the foot. The shelf holds 4 columns of 173 px contained thumbnails with the selection ring. The page does not scroll.
BEFORE: the Refine modal. 460 px wide, a 72 px thumbnail of the source, the page dimmed behind it.

AFTER: the Refine drawer over the shelf, opened with E on image 11 and focused on Strength. Scale segments show their output sizes, strength chips come from the FLUX default (0.1), and 'Passes of image 11 (1)' is listed. The source stays at 1024x1024 in the stage.

AFTER: S on a selected grid image. The run's sheet spans stage and shelf (2104 px), and the 2x4 matrix fits without page scroll.

AFTER, --step 0.3: a 3-run job with one more queued. The status block shows bars, run 1/3, 15/28, Pause/Cancel, queue and 'elapsed · left'. The live preview is over the dimmed last image, and the tab title reads 'run 1/3 · Local Diffusion'.
AFTER: '[' hides the controls; a Generate button appears in the topbar. The shelf still holds the sheet's run:<id> search after Sheet off, so M90 is not fixed by this direction.

AFTER at 1400x900, the smoke size: no shell, two columns, focus 576 px (a 1024² at 524 px, smaller than today's 612), caption truncated. This is why the behaviour changes should be gated at 1600 too.

ITERATION 1, kept to show what changed. The stagebar overflowed into the shelf: the nowrap caption sized the stage grid's auto column, fixed with grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr). The image was 911 px, not 1:1; moving status into the strip row and the legend into the HUD reclaimed 113 px.

risks: Removing page scroll at >=1600 moves the 'Load more' trigger inside the shelf's scroller. The IntersectionObserver at app.js:169-172 uses the viewport root with rootMargin 400px, and that margin does not apply to an inner scroller's clip, so paging fires late. Set root to the shelf scroller. window.scrollTo in reuseIntoPanel (gallery.js:401) becomes a no-op, which is harmless. smoke-paging.json scrolls the window and must scroll the shelf instead.

The rail's overflow-y:auto clips anything absolutely positioned inside it: the .tip panels (style.css:144-158), the Examples menu and the tag menu (left:-68px). These need the popover attribute (top layer) or fixed positioning at >=1600, or they will be cut at the rail's edges and bottom.

Click semantics change. A thumbnail click selects (panel.js:296 img.onclick), and double-click, or Enter on the selected image, opens the lightbox. smoke.json clicks and double-clicks images to open and zoom the lightbox. Gate this at >=1600, keep click = lightbox in the sheet, and have thumb() pass an explicit 'via key' flag; the prototype's window.event is a shortcut, not production code.

A non-modal Refine drawer removes the inert page and the focus trap. The page behind stays live, so Generate, Reuse and gallery deletes can happen while it is open. A deleted source is already refused by the server, but syncRefine must handle it in place. app.js:259-262 runs the pass on any Ctrl+Enter while the dialog is open; it must check els.refineDialog.contains(e.target).

Compare relies on object-fit: cover matching refine.fitted's scale-to-cover and centre crop, including rounding to 16 px. If the backend's crop offset differs by a pixel or two, a 1:1 swipe shows a shimmer that looks like a model change. Derive the crop rectangle from the same arithmetic, or have the record carry its crop box.
The session strip keeps up to VIEWER_MAX (48) full-resolution PNGs per session (thumb(rec, viewerRecords, rec.url)). It should use thumb_url, falling back to url, now that the tiles are 76 px tall.

At 1400x900 (all current smokes) the prototype's stage is busier than today: focus 576 px against 612, and a truncated caption. Unless every behaviour change is gated at 1600, this regresses laptop-size use.

Hiding the card tool rows removes the one-click per-card actions mouse users have today (Star or Delete without selecting). Selection plus F/Delete is two actions where today is one. Mitigate with a hover star on cards (M85's badge-as-toggle).
resetGallery on job done (generation.js:480) still empties and refills the shelf, resetting its scroll (M39). The selection ring is re-applied, but the scroll position is lost until prependNew lands.

The prototype wraps page functions by reassigning global function bindings (openLightbox, appendResult, clearResults, openRefine, runRefine, syncRefine, setSheet, placeTagValidation). A real implementation must change those functions in their own files. It also showed one injection bug: it assumed the viewer placeholder exists, which is false when a job was reattached at load.
rule_conflicts: CLAUDE.md, Frontend: 'On a two-column page validation lives above the results, not in the panel; under 901 px the same node returns below Prompt. The prompt check's panel follows it…'. The direction puts the chips under the prompt at >=1600 (the reason, a sticky panel pushing Generate down, is gone once the rail scrolls and Generate is sticky) and the check over the shelf. Keep placeTagValidation as the one mover with moveBefore and focus/selection restore. Keep #tag-validation-wide as the check's host, moved into the shelf, so checkFromButton's predicate (analysis.js:113-114) and 'Check pressed on a two-column page moves focus to the panel heading' still hold. smoke-analysis.json's 'chips and the check moving from the wide host back under the prompt' needs a >=1600 variant.

CLAUDE.md / design-notes 'The refine pass' (A dialog, not a mode of the panel) and index.html's comment 'Modal like the lightbox: focus stays inside, Escape closes it'. The drawer keeps the rule's purpose: collect() sends refine: null; the drawer has its own size, strength, versions and seed; refineSource is the record while open and null once closed; Ctrl+Enter in it runs the pass. Two things change at >=1600: it is non-modal (show()), and Escape leaves the drawer before closing it. Below 1600 it stays modal. smoke-refine.json expects document.activeElement === els.refineRun on open and Escape to close; under the direction, focus goes to Strength (M108). Update those expectations, or run them only below 1600.

CLAUDE.md: 'Ctrl+Enter in the dialog runs the pass, not Generate'. Kept, but app.js:259-262 must route by focus (els.refineDialog.contains(e.target)), or a non-modal drawer turns every Ctrl+Enter in the prompt box into a pass.

design-notes 'The running batch on wide screens' (8 equal columns for the many tier at >=2000 px). This is superseded by the session strip plus the focus view. The rule's goal of more than 7 results per row at QHD is kept: the strip shows about 16 76-px tiles. Rewrite the note and drop style.css:683-690 at >=1600.

design-notes 'The lightbox zooms' and CLAUDE.md's 1:1 rationale (explicit width/left/top, not transforms; divide by devicePixelRatio). The focus and compare views follow the same method in the prototype (layout() sets px sizes and caps fit at 1/dpr). Keep it that way and share the code with layoutLightbox rather than duplicating it.

CLAUDE.md: 'the page script is twelve classic scripts… their top-level bindings stay top-level, and only app.js, the last, runs anything at load'. The stage/compare code should go into lightbox.js and panel.js as declarations with wiring in app.js. A thirteenth file (stage.js) means updating state.js's order comment, index.html, design-notes 'The page script is twelve files' and the CLAUDE.md layout list.

style.css:793-797 'Revealed by keyboard focus and on a coarse pointer too' (card tools). At >=1600 the tools are removed in favour of the selection toolbar. smoke-refine.json and smoke-conditioning.json find '.card .tools button' and click it with JS. Keep the tool buttons in the DOM (display:none still clicks) or move those smokes to the toolbar's data-act buttons.

CLAUDE.md: 'A ⤢ on a checkpoint without a pass says so and opens nothing'. The toolbar's Refine is aria-disabled with the reason as its title. Its click must still call openRefine so the refusal is said in place; the prototype only no-ops. smoke-conditioning.json's 'both Refine buttons answering with the reason' needs the toolbar button added.
CLAUDE.md: 'opens its submission (job:<id>) as the sheet when done' and 'The sheet asks for the whole run in one page'. Unchanged; the sheet now spans stage and shelf.

CLAUDE.md: panel persistence 'with every access in try/catch; resetPanel is the one thing that forgets it'. New per-viewer prefs (card size S/M/L, rail collapsed) go under local-diffusion.* keys through remembered/remember. Decide explicitly whether resetPanel forgets them; recommendation: no, they are view preferences, not panel state.

smoke-preview.json looks for the live preview in #viewer. At >=1600 the preview moves into .focus as .focus-preview. dropPreview's previewEl.remove() works wherever the element is, but the smoke's selector needs a wide variant.

tools/browser.mjs runs everything at 1400x900. Add the scratch copy's VIEWPORT/DPR env and a smoke-loop.json at 2560x1305 covering: select vs open, toolbar keys, compare after a pass, drawer stay-open, Ctrl+Enter routing, shelf paging and no page scroll.
directions.effort_estimate:
About 9-11 working days for one developer, with no build step needed.

| Area | Days |
|---|---|
| Tokens and rail polish | 1 |
| App shell with shelf scroller and paging root | 1.5 |
| Status block and title | 0.5 |
| Selection, focus view and toolbar | 2 |
| Session strip | 0.5 |
| Compare view, sharing the lightbox's layout code | 1.5 |
| Refine drawer (non-modal, crop frame, chips, passes list, stay-open, Ctrl+Enter routing) | 1.5 |
| Keyboard layer and Keys popover | 0.5-1 |
| New smoke-loop.json, browser.mjs viewport option, edits to smoke.json / smoke-refine / smoke-analysis / smoke-paging / smoke-preview | 1.5-2 |
| design-notes and CLAUDE.md rule rewrites | 0.5 |

The prototype is about 760 lines of JS and 330 lines of CSS. Production code should land at roughly 600-800 JS lines spread over panel.js, gallery.js, lightbox.js, refine.js and app.js, plus about 350 CSS lines.
phasing: 1. Tokens only, no layout change. Add :root tokens, color-scheme: dark, --line-strong borders, ::placeholder colour, the .primary fill, preset dot vs accent, 15 px at >=2200, and Sampling/Output headings. Every smoke stays green. Resolves M17, M30, M31, M36, M74, M78, M84.

2. App shell at >=1600 only. Three columns; the rail scrolls itself with a sticky Generate; .gallery-head, #gallery, #sheet and #btn-more move into the shelf with its own scroller and an IntersectionObserver rooted on it; the sheet spans stage and shelf; chips go under the prompt and the check over the shelf (placeTagValidation). Click still opens the lightbox, so behaviour is unchanged. Resolves M1, M3, M4, M14, M16, M21, M27.
3. Status block at the stage's foot. Move #progress, #queue-note, #cell-note, #error and #last-run; hide last-run while a job is watched; put progress in document.title. Resolves M19, M24, M25.

4. Selection and focus view. Clicking a thumbnail selects at >=1600 (explicit flag from thumb()); double-click or Enter on the selected image opens the lightbox; add the stagebar caption with lineage chip and keyed actions; contained thumbnails with hover caption and refined chip; card tools hidden at >=1600; arrow keys in the shelf. Resolves M11, M15, M20, M34, M35, M43, M45, M46, M88. Add smoke-loop.json at 2560x1305.
5. Session strip. #viewer becomes the horizontal strip across jobs using thumb_url; the live preview overlays the dimmed focus image. Resolves M40, M41, M67.
6. Compare view. Swipe, side by side and hold-B flip with shared zoom and pan from the lightbox's layout code; a pass opens straight into Swipe against its source; Pin A for any pair. Resolves M5.

7. Refine drawer at >=1600. show() over the shelf; Strength focused; output size on each scale segment; strength chips from refine_strength; kept-region frame on the stage; 'Passes of image N' list; stays open after Refine with what was typed; Ctrl+Enter routed by focus (app.js:259); Escape steps out, then closes. Update smoke-refine for >=1600. Resolves M6, M28, M29, M49, M51, M52, M91, M92, M108.
8. Keys. Keys popover, kbd on Generate and Refine, the grid-fold Ctrl+Enter going to Run grid, rail collapse with '[' and a topbar Generate. Resolves M7, M70, M26.

scores.name: Same bones, real scale
scores.comments:
Fixes the user's stated complaints: everything is too small at QHD, space is wasted, and the check pushes the image down. The cost is low. Seen in after-main: panel 461 px, body 15.5 px, Generate at y≈993, 8 gallery cards of 241 px and the first row above the fold. In after-check the check sits beside the viewer at 691 px and the gallery head does not move (y≈921, against 1604 today). At 2048x1040@1.25 the density tier keeps Generate on screen at y=878. Every rule is gated at >=1800, and after-1400-main shows the smoke size unchanged apart from the two headings and the fold.

Weak points:
- It leaves three high findings untouched: M5 (comparing a pass with its source, the user's main Refine pain), M4 (the sheet opens below the fold) and M9.
- The 58vh cap shrinks the just-made image from 887 to 757 px, and about 440 px stays empty on each side of image plus result column (after-main).
- Refine stays a modal. It gains a large source with a crop frame, but the result still lands in the panel about 1,000 px away (M52).
- 'kept: 56%' is less exact than Studio's 'keeps the middle 100% × 67%'.

Lowest risk of the three: mostly CSS, no change to click semantics, no nested scroll containers clipping the .tip spans.

scores.name: Studio workbench
scores.comments:
Uses QHD best. The page never scrolls. The 896x1152 render shows at 868x1116, and 20 library cards are visible beside it. The inspector's labelled facts and actions (Refine…, Use seed, Re-render, Delete) suit an occasional user better than glyph tools. The sheet opens in the canvas, which fixes M4. A pass lands beside its source at the same size, with a lineage chip linking image 5 (after-03c), which covers part of M5.

Costs:
- At 2048x1040 the control column already scrolls inside itself: in after125-01-main the Seed/Batch/Runs row is cut off behind the pinned Generate.
- With the check open, the canvas shrinks to about 985 px (after-04-check).
- Every ? tip needed a JS 'lift' to escape overflow:auto, and the tag menu on tag checkpoints was not exercised.
- Select-then-zoom changes what a card click does, breaking smoke.json's card click and existing habit.
- A non-modal Refine that re-points to whichever card is clicked edges back toward the 'mode' the 2026-10-04 'A dialog, not a mode of the panel' note retired.
- It needs a thirteenth script file and an IntersectionObserver re-rooted on the rail.

Estimated 6-8 days.

scores.name: Image-first loop
scores.comments:
The best Refine story:
- the source at exactly 1024x1024;
- strength chips built from the profile default (0.05/0.1/0.2 on FLUX), which fixes M29;
- a 'Passes of image 11' list;
- a swipe or side-by-side compare with one shared zoom (after-refine-landed, after-compare-zoom), which fully fixes M5 and M11;
- Ctrl+Enter routed by focus, which fixes M7.

Costs:
- It is keyboard-first: F/R/E/C/A/S/B/[ plus a Pin-A-then-C idea. That is hard for an occasional user.
- Removing the card tools turns Star or Delete into two actions.
- At 125% the presets wrap to 3 rows with a 4 MP orphan and an oversized Orientation box, and the stagebar caption truncates ('Image 15 · 1024×1024 · seed 32 ...', after125-main).

grafts.idea: Swipe and side-by-side compare of a refine pass against its source, with both layers on one zoom and pan. Put it in the existing lightbox rather than a new stage: layoutLightbox already does explicit width/left/top and divides by devicePixelRatio. Toggle it with 'Compare with source (S)' in .lb-side when rec.refine != null; the source is cover-cropped by refine.fitted's own arithmetic. Resolves M5, and M49 in part.

Strength chips under the Refine dialog's Strength box, built from refineDefaultStrength(): on FLUX '0.05 lighter · 0.1 default · 0.2 stronger · sweep 0.05,0.1,0.15,0.2'. They replace the 0.4 placeholder that repaints FLUX. Resolves M29.
'Passes of image N (k)' thumbnails inside the Refine dialog: earlier passes of this source, newest first. Clicking one opens the lightbox compare. Partly resolves M49.

Ctrl+Enter routed by where focus is (app.js:257-262): inside #refine-dialog it runs the pass, inside #grid-section it clicks Run grid, anywhere else it runs Generate. This stops a grid fold's Ctrl+Enter rendering literal {placeholders}. Resolves M7.
Progress in document.title ('run 1/3 · 54% — Local Diffusion', '⏸ Paused', '✓ Finished 4 images'), and a hover caption 'id · W×H · seed' on gallery cards. Resolve M24 (part) and M20.

A facts grid (Model·quant, Size, Seed, Steps, CFG, True CFG, Mu, LoRA, Time) with labelled 'Use seed' and 'Reuse settings' actions. Use it in the viewer's result column and the lightbox side column, rendered by one shared helper so the two stay in step. Resolves M32 and M47, and M43 in part.

A lineage chip on a pass, '⤢ Refine pass of image 5 at strength 0.1', whose link shows the source, plus a '⤢ 0.1' badge on refined cards. A pass that just landed shows beside its source at the same displayed size. Resolves M34, M93 (part) and M5 (part).
Batches of 2-4 laid out as an equal 2x2 grid (552 px cells at QHD, 444 px today). Resolves M41.
The crop caption in measured terms: 'keeps the middle 100% × 67%' / 'the whole frame is kept'. Also focus Strength with its value selected when Refine opens. Resolve M51 and M108.
